title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.39149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Textual skills enable large language model (LLM) based agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. Yet existing skill evolution remains largely confined to the text space: an optimizer must diagnose success and failure patterns, and revise skills solely from long execution trajectories and sparse task outcomes. This text-only paradigm leaves the agent's internal representations, which contain rich records of its evolving execution state, outside the skill optimization loop. We ask whether an agent can improve its external textual skills by reflecting on its own internal representations. We introduce Rep2Skill, a representation-guided framework for self-evolution on agent skills. Specifically, upon the collected agent rollouts, Rep2Skill models their internal model representation trajectories to localize turns that deviate from successful execution dynamics, and it further interprets these signals

translated_title: Rep2Skill：面向LLM智能体的表示引导技能自我进化
translated_abstract: 文本技能使基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能够在不更新模型参数的情况下积累可复用的程序性知识。然而，现有的技能进化在很大程度上仍局限于文本空间：优化器必须诊断成功与失败模式，并且只能依靠冗长的执行轨迹和稀疏的任务结果来修订技能。这种纯文本范式将智能体的内部表示——其中包含着其不断演变的执行状态的丰富记录——排除在技能优化循环之外。我们提出了这样一个问题：智能体能否通过反思自身的内部表示来改进其外部文本技能？我们提出了Rep2Skill，一个表示引导的智能体技能自我进化框架。具体而言，在收集到的智能体轨迹上，Rep2Skill对其内部模型表示轨迹进行建模，以定位偏离成功执行动态的交互轮次，并进一步解释这些信号
tldr: Rep2Skill提出了一种表示引导的框架，通过建模智能体的内部表示轨迹来定位偏离成功执行动态的轮次，使LLM智能体能够借助内部表示信号实现外部文本技能的自我进化。
en_tdlr: Rep2Skill introduces a representation-guided framework that models agents' internal representation trajectories to localize turns deviating from successful execution dynamics, enabling LLM agents to self-evolve their textual skills by leveraging internal representation signals.
